title: OP Prison Hax Menu by AP
features:
COMBAT
- Aimbot:
  Toggle (U key)
  Head / Torso targeting
  Adjustable FOV & smoothing
- Killaura (more effective with crude knife)
- Grab Guns: Remington 870, MP5, AK-47, Criminal Remington

POLICE ONLY
- Automatically arrest all criminals
- Arrest a selected criminal from dropdown

WORLD
- Flight with adjustable speed (doesn't get you kicked)
- TP-Fly with speed control
- WalkSpeed & JumpPower sliders
- Infinite Jump
- Click Teleport
- Player ESP toggle
- Vehicle boost with multiplier slider
- Player spectate mode (CapsLock to exit)
- Map modifications (remove fences, walls, doors, BTools)

TELEPORTS
- Teleport to any player via dropdown
- Undo last teleport (step through teleport history)
- Prison locations (Guard Room, Courtyard, Cell Block, Cafeteria,
  Roof, Gate Room, Front Room, Sewer Entrance, Secret Room)
- Prison item pickups (Crude Knife, Hammer, MP5, Remington)
- Criminal base teleports (Spawn, AK-47, Remington)
- Vehicle spawn teleports (Criminal Base, City, Police)
- Misc locations (Secret Bridge Room, Outside Prison)
